Divide a curve in points with additional options

**Panel:** Comma → Curve · **Nickname:** `Divide+`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Curve | `C` | Curve | Item |  | Curve to divide |
| Distribution | `D` | Integer | Item | `0` | Method to divide<br>Options: Equal distribution by number; Equal distribution by target length; By exact spacing (flexible first); By exact spacing (flexible middle); By exact spacing (flexible last); By exact spacing (flexible first and last); By exact spacings |
| Length | `L` | Number | Item | `1000` | Length of segments |
| Count | `N` | Integer | Item | `10` | Number of segments |
| Exclude | `E` | Integer | Item | `0` | Exclude options<br>Options: None (all included); First; Last; First and last; Second; Second to last; Second and second to last |
| Spacings | `S` | Text | Item | `"115 15*200 115"` | Exact spacing values for 'By exact spacings' mode.<br>Format: space-separated values, use N\*L for N repetitions of length L.<br>Example: "115 15\*200 115"<br>Remainder is left at the end. |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Points | `P` | Point | List | Division points |
| Tangents | `T` | Vector | List | Tangent vectors at division points |
| Parameters | `t` | Number | List | Parameter values at division points |
